parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.

Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.

swap_risks: CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AMS1117-3.3: 22 µF p.4 vs NCP1117LPST33T3G: 10 µF p.2); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
CAUTION ESR STABILITY WINDOW: Both parts are ESR-constrained, but AMS1117-3.3 omits explicit numeric ESR bounds (See datasheet ESR curve vs 0.02–20 Ω (p.2)); verify the datasheet ESR-vs-Iout curve.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: NCP1117LPST33T3G is rated to only 12 V rec. (18 V abs max, p.2) vs AMS1117-3.3 at 15 V rec. (15 V abs max, p.2). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AMS1117-3.3: 1100 mV p.3 vs NCP1117LPST33T3G: 1300 mV p.3); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AMS1117-3.3 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (15 V, p.2) than NCP1117LPST33T3G (18 V, p.2); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 15 V.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AMS1117-3.3: -40..125 °C Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ) vs NCP1117LPST33T3G: 0..125 °C Commercial (0°C to +125°C TA/TJ)); NCP1117LPST33T3G cold limit only 0 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AMS1117-3.3 (Advanced Monolithic Systems, SOT-223-3) and NCP1117LPST33T3G (onsemi, SOT-223-3) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.2x; ESR-constrained output capacitor window unverified on one part; Vin,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 22.9 °C on AMS1117-3.3 (θJA 90 °C/W) vs 27.5 °C on NCP1117LPST33T3G (θJA 108 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 9.1x ratio (5000 µA (p.3) vs 550 µA (p.3)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AMS1117-3.3 "NOT Ceramic-Cap Stable — Requires 22 uF Solid Tantalum (No Numeric ESR Window Published)" (p.4) and NCP1117LPST33T3G "20 mOhm Minimum ESR Floor Still Blocks Bare Low-ESR MLCCs Despite Modern 'LP' Label" (p.2). BOM decision: Choose AMS1117-3.3 when input rails climb above 12 V (rated to 15 V) or lower package θJA (90 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin; choose NCP1117LPST33T3G when battery sleep budget demands 550 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
